description: Every rule assigning exactly one output set to every ordinal and every set-function history on it determines a unique ordinal-indexed function satisfying the rule. Its graph on each ordinal domain is a recursive set-function; these graphs agree under restriction, and the values on each such domain form a set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.TransfiniteRecursion.class_function_exists_unique.{u}
  (Φ : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.TransfiniteRecursion.Rule) (hΦ : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.TransfiniteRecursion.IsTotalRule Φ) :
  ∃! f,
    (∀ (α : Ordinal.{u}), Φ α (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.TransfiniteRecursion.graph f α) (f α)) ∧
      (∀ (θ : Ordinal.{u}),
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.TransfiniteRecursion.IsRecursiveSolution Φ θ
            (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.TransfiniteRecursion.graph f θ)) ∧
        (∀ (η θ : Ordinal.{u}),
            η ≤ θ →
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.TransfiniteRecursion.restrict (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.TransfiniteRecursion.graph f θ)
                  η.toZFSet =
                Lemmatheca.SetTheory.TransfiniteRecursion.graph f η) ∧
          ∀ (θ : Ordinal.{u}), ∃ B, ∀ (y : ZFSet.{u}), y ∈ B ↔ ∃ α < θ, f α = y
